title: Quickly Grilled Uruguayan Meat Asado
description: A sick-day Uruguayan dish featuring tender meat, sour cream, and a hint of smokiness. It's perfect for a relaxing dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Grass-fed beef (skirt steak or flap meat)

instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place the beef on a piece of agave, folding the leaf over the meat to form a packet.
Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the beef to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
While the beef is resting, grill the onions until they're caramelized and slightly charred.
Stir in a tablespoon of sour cream and a pinch of salt.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with the onions and sour cream.
